title: Zones de fréquence cardiaque
description: Temps passé par zone de FC (mart.hr_zone_time), dérivé de l'histogramme à 1 bpm : recalculable pour n'importe quel jeu de bornes par un simple REFRESH (COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.hr_zone_time).

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

panels.title: Temps par zone — chronologie
panels.description: Secondes par zone (mart.hr_zone_time.zone_code), par jour, empilées.

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.local_date::timestamp AS time, z.zone_code AS metric, sum(z.seconds) AS value FROM mart.hr_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY z.local_date, z.zone_code ORDER BY z.local_date

panels.title: Temps total par zone — période sélectionnée
panels.description: Somme des secondes par zone_code sur la période, ordonnée par mart.hr_zone_time.zone_order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.zone_code AS "Zone", z.zone_order AS "Ordre", sum(z.seconds) AS "Secondes" FROM mart.hr_zone_time z JOIN core.activity a ON a.activity_id = z.activity_id WHERE a.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(z.local_date) GROUP BY z.zone_code, z.zone_order ORDER BY z.zone_order
